QuestInfo.name: [Root Abyss] World Tree Guardian
QuestInfo.0: Tell Neinheart what happened in the Root Abyss, and find a way to break the seal on the World Tree.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat all seal guardians and remove the seal on the World Tree.
QuestInfo.2: You removed the seal on the World Tree trapped in the Root Abyss and moved her to Ereve.

1.0: Thank you. The World Tree is safe thanks to your efforts.
1.1: The Maple Alliance has decided to present you with the #r<World Tree Guardian>#k title and medal.

yes.0: The World Tree is safe now, but the threat is still very much there. The culprit who sealed the World Tree in the first place is attempting to #rresurrect the seal guardians#k. Victoria Island will be in big trouble if that happens.
yes.1: Your continued attention to this matter is both important and expected. The fate of Maple World rests on your shoulders.

default.0: Remove the seal on the World Tree and escort it to Ereve.
